in_sanskrit.name: शायम्लाल
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is cool and calm like Shayam (another name for Lord Krishna) + Lal (meaning friend or dear one)

in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who is cool and calm like Shayam (another name for Lord Krishna) + Lal (meaning friend or dear one)

in_tamil.name: Shyamlal
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் God of Earth
in_tamil.long_meaning: Shyamlal ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Shyamlal is a combination of two words - Shyaam (God of Earth) and Lal (red). This name represents the power and strength of the earth and the god that protects it.

in_telugu.name: Shyamlal
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే God of Earth
in_telugu.long_meaning: Shyamlal ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Shyamlal is a combination of two words - Shyaam (God of Earth) and Lal (red). This name represents the power and strength of the earth and the god that protects it.
